company.name: Spruce Health
company.shortDescription: Spruce thinks of a better way to see the doctor by using their platform for communication.
company.description:
Spruce thinks of a better way to see the doctor by using their platform for communication. 

They think getting great health care in America involves too much waiting and hassle and healthcare pricing should be affordable and involve no surprises. They think the experience of “going to the doctor” can be dramatically improved for both patients and physicians through software to enrich the patient-physician relationship and improve quality, safety, and satisfaction.

They’re committed to building quality healthcare experiences that are accessible anytime, anywhere.
